label: Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 has the POTENCY_3 capacity to understand
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1) is able to be actually understanding: CapacityPotency CanBe x understanding, the CanBe (POTENCY_3, DEF-CAPACITY-TO-BE) of the Metaphysics IX.6 analysis at the respect of understanding (39f50105). It does not say the being is understanding, nor that it is in potency to understanding: a being actually understanding is also able to understand (the capacity is retained in exercise, DISAMB-POTENCY). Intellect is here a standing capacity whose exercise is understanding. Example: a sleeping geometer. Control part 1: the other two premises hold, a being has the nine, and the nine's operation fails without it.
